finite_search.static_screen: Ideal rigid flat-ground eight-point equilibrium; payload gravity wrench at nominal COM transmitted to head. No clamping pressure/compliance or PD guarantee.

ground_endpoint_screen.scope: Finite endpoints and sampled jaw closure only. Query all 11 robot hulls against every sample leaf; actual robot SI/geoms preserved. Closure stops at first lower-bar contact or other collision. No continuous approach/sweep, grasp dynamics, compliance or material qualification.

isolated_contact_bench.scope: Preplaced free object, fixed head, native actual two jaw hulls and four-bar; no object attachment or full robot balance. Contact and material quality remain unqualified.
